limitations: Local Compose render or helper validation does not qualify Sakura startup, HTTPS, tenant isolation or persistence.
Successful core gate execution can issue PILOT_PARTIAL only; it never qualifies unsupported GroupDM or a full pilot.
Operator supplied commit and restart records require independent deployment evidence.
FileSharing=false denies intake; a read-only Files release additionally requires denial of every prohibited modifying operation and passing authorized reads/downloads.
Backup, restore, deployment and real-user admission require the Owner's authorized target and execution window.
